Green-lipped Mussel Extracto de mejillón de labios verdes. Зеленого Губчатого Моллюска Profile An extract from the green-lipped mussel Perna canaliculus (My- tilidae), stated to contain omega-3 polyunsaturated fatty acids, amino acids, fats, carbohydrates, and minerals, has been promot- ed for the treatment of rheumatic disorders including rheumatoid arthritis (p.11). It has also been tried in asthma. Rheumatic disorders. Reviews of the investigation of green- lipped mussel in the treatment of arthritis have not revealed con- clusive evidence of its usefulness.1,2 1. Li Wan Po A, Maguire T. Green-lipped mussel. Pharm J 1990; 244: 640–1. 2. Cobb CS, Ernst E. Systematic review of a marine nutriceutical supplement in clinical trials for arthritis: the effectiveness of the New Zealand green-lipped mussel Perna canaliculus. Clin Rheumatol 2006; 25: 275–84.
